attractions.name: St. Dominic Church (Minor Basilica of Saint Dominic)
attractions.description: Centuries-old parish church (site completed 1773; rebuilt 1803); Minor Basilica since 2022/2023; historically among the largest churches in the Philippines.

attractions.name: Speaker Eugenio Perez Memorial Building (Museum)
attractions.description: Memorial building and museum honoring the late Speaker of the House from San Carlos.

attractions.name: City Plaza
attractions.description: Heritage park and public plaza in the Poblacion.

attractions.name: Shopping malls and supermarkets
attractions.description: Commercial tourism assets around the downtown ("Las Bellas Carlenians").

Mapita Falls

attractions.name: Mount Zion Pilgrim Mountain

attractions.name: Kabaleyan Cove Resort

festival.name: Mango-Bamboo Festival
festival.schedule: Last week of April, annually (often a week-long event)
festival.purpose: Promotes San Carlos as the major trading center for bamboo-based products and furniture, and a top producer of carabao mangoes; brands the city as the "Mango-Bamboo Capital of the North".
activities: Float parade with mango and bamboo decorations
Street dancing competition among barangay contingents
Culinary contests - mango pie showcase and mango-based dishes
Variety shows and Laro ng Lahi (native sports)
festival.activities_status: historical programming from the archived LGU tourism page
